Several of the younger competitors managed to do the walk and the run and of these the most successful was Raymond McCann who won the former and still had enough left to get up to 5th over the same distance in the run, won convincingly by Matthew Cannon.
David North was a good winner in 12:20 and was followed home by 3rd G.Price 13:00, 6th G.Williscroft 13:30, 12.A.Horton 14:56 and 13th R.McCann 15:04.

David North scored a convincing win, with the improving Mark Sinclair fourth and in eighth position the diminutive Gary Williscroft. Later a blood-stained Ray McCann (he had had a fall) stormed in. Scoring three a side we won from the local club.

John Gladwin was overcome by the heat and pulled out after one lap of the Youths race (he thought it was a one lap race as did the other Youths!) Colts: 1.A.Hawkins (Cambridge H) 11:00; 55.R.McCann 12:57; 61.R.

Simon Simpson and Ray McCann were very disappointed with the other Colts who didn't turn up and it showed in the way they ran. If only we had a dozen more like these two - their enthusiasm and willingness to compete on every occasion puts the rest of the Club to shame.
